name: Oriana
source:
A blunt, bespectacled beauty resolute in her morals. Lying dormant under her icy exterior seems to be a myriad of emotions...

"I wonder if this place holds some dark secret..."

[From [url=https://junkakeru.itch.io/yet-another-killing-game]itch.io[/url]]
